title: Platform Bootstrap Configuration
description: Configuration for the GitOps addon management platform. Copy to config.local.yaml and customize.

allOf.description: AWS fields are required for every provider except the Azure provider.
The Azure provider requires a complete azure block.

clusterProvider.description: Which cluster provider to use for hub provisioning

url.description: Git repository URL hosting the platform code

revision.description: Git branch or tag to deploy from

basepath.description: Path within the repo to the gitops directory (must end with /)

fleetRepo.description: Optional. Repository hosting FLEET content (fleet/members, fleet/spoke-values, overlays) when it lives apart from the platform charts — e.g. a consumer repo that owns its own fleet while consuming platform addons from repo.url. Each field falls back independently to the matching repo.* value when omitted. Honoured by the kind-crossplane and kind-kro-ack providers.

url.description: Git repository URL hosting the fleet content. Defaults to repo.url

revision.description: Git branch or tag for the fleet content. Defaults to repo.revision

basepath.description: Path within the fleet repo to the gitops directory (must end with /). Defaults to repo.basepath

clusterName.description: EKS cluster name. Must be DNS-compatible, unique per account+region. Used to prefix IAM roles and Secrets Manager keys.

vpcCidr.description: VPC CIDR block. Must not overlap with other stacks if VPC peering is needed.

enabled.description: Enable a managed node group alongside EKS Auto Mode

instanceTypes.description: EC2 instance types for the node group

capabilities.description: Managed EKS Capabilities (KRO / ACK) for the hub, created via provider-aws-eks Capability MRs in the platform-cluster Composition.

enabled.description: Enable the Managed KRO capability (serves ResourceGraphDefinitions).
Enable the Managed ACK capability (GA AWS service controllers: iam/s3/…).

profile.description: AWS CLI profile name (local dev only)

domain.description: Ingress hostname for the platform, provisioned by the CONSUMER (Route53, CloudFront, etc.). The platform never creates it. Used for ingress host rules and printed URLs. Must be unique per stack.

insecure.description: When true, platform ingress serves plain HTTP (no cert) — the consumer terminates TLS upstream (e.g. CloudFront). When false (default), the ALB serves HTTPS and uses an ACM cert (auto-discovered by host, or certificateArn if set).

certificateArn.description: Optional ACM certificate ARN for the ALB HTTPS listener when insecure=false. If empty, the AWS Load Balancer Controller auto-discovers an ACM cert matching the domain.

resourcePrefix.description: Prefix for KRO tenant-facing resources (ECR repos, S3 buckets). Infrastructure resources use clusterName instead.

platformTags.description: Platform-wide AWS tags applied to every AWS resource the platform creates: hub resources (EKS cluster, VPC, NAT, EIP) via CDK Tags.of(stack).add() in platform-engineering-on-eks, and spoke resources via the kro EksclusterWithVpc `awsTags` schema field (threaded through the hub cluster-secret `platform_tags` annotation). Primary use: SpringClean retention (auto-delete=no) so cost/janitor sweepers do not reap long-lived workshop infrastructure; also cost allocation and compliance. Values must be strings.

ingressName.description: ALB ingress group name. Defaults to {clusterName}-ingress if empty.

ingressSecurityGroups.description: Comma-separated security group IDs for the ALB

adminRoleName.description: IAM role name added as a cluster-admin access entry and used by Backstage templates for cluster access.

identityCenter.description: AWS Identity Center config for EKS ArgoCD Capability

adminGroupId.description: Identity Center admin group ID for ArgoCD access

azure.description: Azure configuration — required when clusterProvider is 'kind-crossplane-azure'

location.description: Azure region. Do not hardcode — read from Bootstrap Key Vault at runtime.

uamiClientId.description: User-Assigned Managed Identity client ID (from AVM module). Used for both GitHub Actions OIDC and Kind bootstrap Workload Identity.

resourceGroup.description: Pre-existing Azure Resource Group name (from AVM module)

keyVaultName.description: Azure Key Vault name (max 24 chars). Defaults to <clusterName[:12]>-kv if omitted.

kindClusterName.description: Existing Kind bootstrap cluster to adopt. Defaults to <hub.clusterName>-bootstrap. Set this when the cluster is already running under a different name; it is never renamed or recreated.

oidcIssuerUrl.description: Issuer already configured on the running Kind API server. When set, publication reuses the cluster's own public JWKS: no storage account is created and no signing key is generated or read.

oidcStorageAccount.description: Storage account hosting the public issuer. Defaults to the cluster name with hyphens stripped, truncated to 20 chars.

oidcStorageContainer.description: Container holding the public issuer documents. Defaults to $web (static website).

oidcBlobPrefix.description: Blob prefix under the container, used only when the issuer is derived from the static website endpoint. Defaults to oidc.

systemNodeSize.description: AKS system-pool VM SKU. Must be >=4 vCPU (B-series is not supported) and fit the region's family and total vCPU quotas.

systemNodeMax.description: AKS maximum system-pool node count; budget for its full quota requirement.

oidcStorageResourceGroup.description: Resource group of the public OIDC storage account; defaults to azure.resourceGroup.

bootstrapIdentityResourceGroup.description: Resource group of the dedicated bootstrap UAMI; defaults to azure.resourceGroup.

argocdNodeSelector.description: Optional existing node labels for ArgoCD placement; empty preserves chart defaults.

crossplanePrincipalId.description: Optional UAMI object ID for explicit registration IAM tasks.

evidencePath.description: Private IAM journal path; reuse original evidence to preserve revoke/import ownership.

agc.description: Native AKS AGC preview, reconciled by Crossplane before the Gateway addon is enabled.

subnetCidr.description: Nonoverlapping dedicated IPv4 /24 or larger; added as an extra VNet prefix.

vnetCidr.description: VNet CIDR containing the system and user subnets. Must not overlap the AKS service CIDR 10.0.0.0/16.
